interpretation.T: final real-time marginal gains from trade per MWh evaluated in the same precommitted direction
interpretation.causal_claim: NONE; direct measurement, not a causal W2-CQ test
interpretation.price_object: congestion-stripped proxy LMP = energy + marginal loss component; follows ISO-NE market-monitor convention for comparing underlying marginal costs across the seam
interpretation.s: day-ahead marginal gains from trade per MWh in the day-ahead efficient direction
interpretation.wedge: s-T, a directly observed monetary analogue of the option-destruction wedge for a fixed-direction marginal cross-border MWh
